source.description: Blocking-review remediation on PR #108 (nav topology): (1) rebase xt/xjif onto current origin/main; (2) p:$sid:%pane validation must prove the session+pane OCCURRENCE via session-scoped display-message reading #{session_id}+#{pane_id} (bare %pane lookup cannot validate linked-pane occurrences; tmux -t sid:%pane silently falls back to the session current pane); (3) real-tmux regressions for linked-window pane occurrences (TEST D) incl. foreign-claim refusal; (4) ordinary fuzzy search must be ancestry-preserving: pane match retains parent window+session, window match retains parent session — implemented as chain projection bound to fzf change event (list-active-nav-chain), empty query re-emits flat tree verbatim, fields 1-5 byte-identical; (5) actual fuzzy-query behavior tests (contract §36 + real-tmux TEST E, real fzf --filter); (6) rerun merge-result CI, request final review, DO NOT MERGE. Side fix: wire packages/* as bun workspaces so beautiful-mermaid lands in bun.lock (pre-existing main-side CI break).
source.notes:
## Remediation round 2 — CI smoke failure (2026-08-18T23:05:32Z)

Root cause: production bug in picker_state_read. Under set -euo pipefail, REPLY=$(<missing-file) raises a redirection error that exits the script even under a caller's '|| true'. Cold CI runner (no state files) => list-active-nav* projections exited before rendering => empty output => §36 dispatcher test failed. Pre-existing on main since the original nav commit.

Fix 42e3e7da: [ -f ] guard in picker_state_read (cold-start returns empty). Regression guard: §36 runs all three dispatcher projections against a clean TMPDIR and asserts non-empty flat output; fails on unfixed picker with exact CI signature, passes with fix.

Local on 42e3e7da: nav-contract 308/0, full verify-json-api.sh PASS. Awaiting CI.


## Remediation round 3 — real-tmux TERM (2026-08-19T00:31:59Z)

After the state-dir fix, CI smoke progressed to nav-real-tmux and failed TEST A:
CI job environments have no TERM set, and tmux attach refuses a terminal it
cannot query ('terminal does not support clear'), so the script-wrapped attach
never produced a client. Fix 21afd41: pin TERM=xterm-256color in start_client
and surface the attach log on timeout. Verified 38/0 with TERM unset (CI-like)
and normal; full verify-json-api.sh PASS with env -u TERM.
source.title: PR #108 remediation: occurrence-aware pane validation + ancestry-preserving fuzzy search
